title: Discord Font Generator
description: Generate styled unicode fonts, markdown styling, and ANSI colored text for Discord. Elevate your chat messages, profile status, and server layout.

faqs.question: How do you generate colored text on Discord?
faqs.answer: Discord supports color formatting using ANSI escape codes in triple-backtick code blocks (e.g. ```ansi). This generator automatically outputs the required formatting blocks for various colors.

faqs.question: Will these fonts work in Discord channel names and profile status?
faqs.answer: Yes! Unicode styled fonts will work in channel names, server roles, nickname settings, and custom profile statuses. Discord native markdown (like bold, italics) only works in actual chat messages.

faqs.question: What markdown formatting does Discord support natively?
faqs.answer: Discord supports: **bold**, *italics*, __underline__, ~~strikethrough~~, ||spoiler||, > blockquotes, `inline code`, and ```code blocks```.

educationalContent.whatIsIt: Discord Font Generator is a specialized formatter for Discord users and server admins. It produces native markdown, Unicode fonts, and ANSI color escape sequences that let you colorize and style your text inside chat channels, bios, status settings, and channel lists.
educationalContent.howToUse:
1. Type your message in the input text area.
2. Choose between Light/Dark theme inside the live simulated Discord Chat preview to see how your text appears.
3. Scroll down and browse Unicode fonts, native Discord markdown shortcuts, or the ANSI Color block options.
4. Click "Copy" on your preferred style and paste it into Discord.
proTips: Use ANSI color block generators to create eye-catching announcements, notices, and rules in your server.
Use double-struck or cursive fonts for channel names to organize your Discord server categories in a clean, aesthetic layout.
